svg.title: Spatially grounded tensor-to-LLM interface
svg.desc: A two-stage architecture. In Stage 1, shared input X branches to a value-preserving encoder and a frozen Qwen tokenizer; the paired outputs are read after probes at frozen Qwen layer ell and aligned with a field-text contrastive matrix. Stage 2 tokenizes and embeds a natural-language question, then places its text embeddings directly after the same 256 spatial tokens in a frozen Qwen model.
svg.text: Spatial identity is preserved by constant token count and row-major indexing; attention contextualizes each token without pooling it away.
